::: {#exm-tss}
#### Total sum of squares of three values

For $y = 1, 2, 2$, $\bar y = 5/3$, so

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{TSS}
&= \paren{1 - \tfrac{5}{3}}^2 + 2\paren{2 - \tfrac{5}{3}}^2
&& \text{(definition)}\\
&= \tfrac{4}{9} + \tfrac{2}{9}
&& \text{(square the deviations)}\\
&= \tfrac{2}{3}
&& \text{(arithmetic)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
